snippet.title: [AB+] ALTEREDBLOOD+ DEMO on Itch.io
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW on steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4318080/ALTEREDBLOOD_AB/

DEMO is now live on ITCH.IO:
https://trueworldstudios.itch.io/alteredblood

Spill the blood of your enemies, soak in their blood to awaken your weapons and abilities, bring directionality to your ultraviolence in ALTEREDBLOOD+, a Boomer Shooter/ Platformer.

In a megastructure which has consumed the universe, Human remnants survive, addicted to her blood. 
Embody her Reaper, guide humanity to extinction.
